subject.title: improve(i18n): generate native locales after merge

question: Should this generated-locale publisher receive the requested contents-write authority and land based on the current automated tests, or should it first provide an inspectable post-merge refresh run proving the exact-head generated-PR flow?
rationale: The patch changes a privileged repository automation path; tests establish intended control flow but do not independently establish the live token scope or resulting publication behavior.

options.title: Require live refresh proof and scope review
options.body: Review the custom generated-PR token contract and add redacted output from an after-fix locale refresh that creates, validates, and publishes the generated PR.

options.title: Accept the automation risk
options.body: Land based on the existing workflow tests and Testbox results while accepting that the first real post-merge run will validate the publisher path.

recommendation.title: Require live refresh proof and scope review
recommendation.body: Review the custom generated-PR token contract and add redacted output from an after-fix locale refresh that creates, validates, and publishes the generated PR.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the linked proposal and the workflow implementation, making them the best available contact for the publisher behavior and proof.
